name: ledova-shared-packages
description: Ledova shared packages for Ledova platform

scripts.build:shared: cd packages/shared-constants && npm run build && cd ../shared-types && npm run build && cd ../shared-utils && npm run build && cd ../shared-services && npm run build
scripts.test: cd packages/shared-constants && npx jest && cd ../shared-types && npx jest --passWithNoTests && cd ../shared-utils && npx jest && cd ../shared-services && npx jest --passWithNoTests
scripts.lint: cd packages/shared-constants && npx eslint src && cd ../shared-types && npx eslint src && cd ../shared-utils && npx eslint src && cd ../shared-services && npx eslint src
scripts.lint:fix: npm run format && cd packages/shared-constants && npx eslint --fix src && cd ../shared-types && npx eslint --fix src && cd ../shared-utils && npx eslint --fix src && cd ../shared-services && npx eslint --fix src
scripts.typecheck: cd packages/shared-constants && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../shared-types && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../shared-utils && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../shared-services && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.validate:packages: npm run check-versions && npm run build:shared

author: Ledova Team
